ai.name: Title of alert dialogs that come from the AI features. Use the usual abbreviation for artificial intelligence in your language (AI, KI, IA, ИИ, …).
ai.back: Button that returns from the preview to the input form.
ai.discard: Button that throws away a proposal made by AI.
ai.tryAgain: Button that returns to the input form after an error.
ai.preview: Button that shows exactly what would be sent to the AI provider. Nothing is sent yet.
ai.sendToAi: Button that sends the previewed text to the AI provider.
ai.continueBatch: Button that asks AI for the next batch of requests.
ai.empty: Placeholder shown inside an empty comparison box.
ai.current: Heading of the box that shows the present text, next to Proposed.
ai.proposed: Heading of the box that shows what AI suggests, next to Current.
ai.instructions: Heading above the instructions part of the text sent to AI.
ai.content: Heading above the content part of the text sent to AI.
ai.replyFormat: Heading above the description of the answer format that AI is asked to use.
ai.scriptLabel: Accessible label of the choice between pre-request and post-response script.
ai.preRequest: Option: the script that runs before a request is sent.
ai.postResponse: Option: the script that runs after the response arrives.
ai.providerLabel: {{label}} is the name of the AI provider, for example Anthropic.
ai.waitingFor: {{label}} is the name of the AI provider.
ai.previewNote: {{host}} is a server name, {{size}} is a size such as 2.1 KB, {{tokens}} is a number. Tokens are the units in which AI models count text.
ai.previewNoteValues: Same as previewNote with a second sentence. Sensitive keys are those whose names suggest secrets.
ai.previewNoteStructure: Same as previewNote with a second sentence.
ai.skipPreview: Checkbox. Sets a permanent preference for the action.
ai.needsResponse: Hint shown when an AI action needs a response that does not exist yet.
ai.needsTrust: Hint shown in a folder that the person has not marked as trusted.
ai.badReply: Error shown when the AI answer cannot be understood.
ai.cutOff: Error shown when the AI answer was too long and was truncated.
ai.connected: Result of a successful connection test.
ai.tooLarge: {{size}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as 20 KB.
ai.tasks.request.label: Name of the AI action and title of its dialog.
ai.tasks.request.untitled: Name given to a request drafted by AI when the answer has no name. Saved as the request name.
ai.tasks.tests.label: Name of the AI action. Checks are assertions about a response.
ai.tasks.explain.label: Name of the AI action that explains why a request failed.
ai.tasks.docs.label: Name of the AI action that writes a description for a request.
ai.tasks.search.label: Name of the AI action that finds requests in the collection by description.
ai.tasks.schema.label: Name of the AI action that creates requests from an API description.
ai.tasks.schema.defaultFolder: Name of the folder created for AI generated requests. Saved as the folder name.
ai.tasks.schema.moreNote: Explains that the API is large and the next batch can be requested.
ai.tasks.schema.importerNote: Keep the quoted button name the same as ai.tasks.tests.label.
ai.tasks.schema.importerWarnings: Heading of the list of notes from the importer.
ai.tasks.schema.moreLines: Last line of a truncated list.
ai.buttons.generate: Tooltip or label of a button. Use the usual abbreviation for artificial intelligence in your language (AI, KI, IA, ИИ, …).
ai.commands.request.label: Command palette entry. Starts with AI: followed by the action.
ai.commands.request.keywords: Extra search words, separated by spaces.
ai.commands.settings.keywords: Extra search words, separated by spaces.
ai.settings.offNote: Status text of the AI settings.
ai.settings.needsSetup: Status text of the AI settings.
ai.settings.consent: {{host}} is the name of the AI provider's server.
ai.settings.enableAfterConsent: Label of the switch while the checkbox above is not ticked.
ai.settings.baseUrl: Label of the field for the address of the AI service.
ai.settings.allowInsecure: Checkbox. Plain http is not encrypted.
ai.settings.model: Label of the field for the identifier of the AI model.
ai.settings.listModels: Button that asks the provider which models it offers.
ai.settings.apiKey: Label of the field for the secret key issued by the AI provider.
ai.settings.keySaved: Status text next to the key field.
ai.settings.removeKey: Button that forgets the saved key.
ai.settings.optionalKey: Placeholder of a key field that may stay empty.
ai.settings.remember: Checkbox that decides whether the key survives closing the tab.
ai.settings.test: Button that sends a tiny test message to the provider.
ai.settings.skipped: Count of actions for which the person chose not to see the preview.
ai.settings.askAgain: Button that turns previews back on for all actions.
ai.settings.browserNote: Keep names such as Ollama, OLLAMA_ORIGINS, LM Studio and CORS as written.
ai.settings.forget: Button that turns AI off and removes keys and settings.
ai.settings.forgetWhileOff: Button that removes keys and settings while AI is off.
ai.errors.invalidBase: Error under the address field. No final full stop.
ai.errors.refused: {{status}} is an HTTP status code such as 400.
ai.errors.retryIn: {{summary}} is an error message, {{seconds}} is a number of seconds.
ai.errors.withDetail: {{summary}} is an error message, {{detail}} is a technical message from the provider. Keep it unchanged.
ai.errors.unreachable: {{host}} is a server name, {{advice}} is one of the advice sentences below.
ai.errors.unreachableWithReason: {{host}} is a server name, {{reason}} is a technical message in parentheses, {{advice}} is one of the advice sentences below.
ai.errors.ollamaAdvice: {{origin}} is a web address. Keep OLLAMA_ORIGINS unchanged.
ai.errors.lmStudioAdvice: Keep the command lms server start --cors unchanged.
ai.errors.customAdvice: {{origin}} is a web address. Keep OPTIONS, Authorization and Content-Type unchanged.
ai.close: Button that closes the AI dialog.
ai.tasks.docs.section: Heading of the section in generated documentation that holds a request description. Noun.
ai.providers.local: Name of an AI provider that runs on the person's own computer, in the provider list. {{name}} is a product name such as Ollama or LM Studio.
ai.providers.custom: Entry in the AI provider list for any service that speaks the OpenAI API, reached at an address the person enters.
ai.providers.customModelHint: Placeholder in the model field for a custom provider. The identifier the provider gives to a model.
